verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a Python plugin system (Functions, Tools, Pipes, Filters) and a vendor site that invites users to share what they build and run what others share, so a community sharing ecosystem exists. Nothing in the evidence shows its scale or how actively it is maintained. missing for 10: evidence of thousands of published plugins/presets, evidence of active maintainers or update cadence, independent corroboration that the ecosystem is alive.

support.subject: As a power user, the community ecosystem is genuinely alive — thousands of published skills, plugins, or presets with active maintainers

citations.quote: Share what you build, run what others share.
Functions are modular Python plugins that extend the capabilities of Open WebUI itself.
Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters, and Pipelines execute arbitrary Python code on your server.
